name: Workflow 2 - AI CV Screening Agent Full 13 Steps

parameters.query: SELECT id, position, requirements FROM jobs WHERE id = {{ $json.job_id }} UNION ALL SELECT 0, 'Vị trí chung', 'Kỹ năng làm việc chuyên nghiệp' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO candidates (job_id, name, full_name, applied_position, email, cv_content, match_score, approval_status, status, ai_evaluation)
VALUES (
  {{ Number($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.job_id) || 1 }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.candidate_name) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.candidate_name) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.position || 'Chuyên viên') }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.candidate_email) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.cv_text) }},
  {{ Number($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.match_score) || 0 }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.status) }},
  {{ $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.status === 'APPROVED' ? "'Đạt'" : "'Loại'" }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.ai_evaluation) }}
);

assignments.name: notify_message
assignments.value: =Hồ sơ {{ $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.candidate_name }} đạt {{ $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.match_score }} điểm - Trạng thái: {{ $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.status }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  success: true,
  message: "Sàng lọc CV thành công",
  candidate: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.candidate_name,
  position: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.position,
  match_score: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.match_score,
  status: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.status,
  matched_keywords: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.matched_keywords,
  missing_keywords: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.missing_keywords,
  evaluation: $('Step 7: Calculate Match Score').item.json.ai_evaluation
} }}
